eyebrow.zh: 出海创作者 · 英文母语感

headline.zh:
你的英文帖，
不再一眼被看出是「中国人写的AI稿」。
headline.en:
Your English posts stop reading like
an AI draft written by a Chinese speaker.

sub.zh: Muyu 用 68 条中式英语 tell 规则给草稿打 0-100 母语感分（离线、零模型调用），按 Instagram / TikTok / Substack 平台文风逐段改写（接入你自己的 DeepSeek / Qwen / GLM / Kimi 端点），再复检给出可验证的前后对比。搭配迁移、语序迁移、客气套话、AI 腔——四类痕迹，一次工作台全治。
sub.en: Muyu scores your draft's Chinglish density with 68 built-in tells (offline, zero model calls), rewrites it segment-by-segment for Instagram / TikTok / Substack against your own DeepSeek / Qwen / GLM / Kimi endpoint, then re-scores so the delta is verifiable. Collocation transfers, word-order transfers, politeness formulas, AI cadence - four layers of tells, one workbench.

title.zh: 看得见中文思维留下的痕迹
title.en: It sees what a Chinese-mindset draft leaves behind

body.zh: 英语单语 humanizer 只认识 AI 腔（delve into / It's not just X）。Muyu 的 tell 库专治中文思维直译那一层：open the light、I very like it、Do you know where is the station、Please kindly——68 条规则按搭配迁移 / 语序迁移 / 客气套话 / AI 腔四类组织，每条带中文解释与改写示例，既是检测器也是避坑手册。
body.en: English-only humanizers recognize AI cadence (delve into, It's not just X). Muyu's tell library targets the Chinese-mindset layer underneath: open the light, I very like it, Do you know where is the station, Please kindly - 68 rules across collocation / word-order / politeness / AI-cadence, each with a Chinese explanation and rewrite example. Detector and study guide in one.

title.zh: 打分离线可复现，改进可证伪

body.zh: score 是纯规则评分器：零模型调用、完全离线，同一草稿重复打分分差为 0。rewrite 之后用同一评分器复检，输出分类 delta 报告——改写是不是真的更母语，看数字不看感觉。
body.en: score is a pure-rule scorer: zero model calls, fully offline, byte-stable on repeat runs. After rewriting, the same scorer re-scores and emits a per-category delta report - whether the rewrite actually sounds more native is a number, not a vibe.

title.zh: 你的端点你的模型，平台文风内建
title.en: Your endpoint, your model; platform style built in

body.zh: 改写走你自己配置的 OpenAI 兼容端点，DeepSeek / Qwen / GLM / Kimi 一键预设，无账号无中间商。Instagram / TikTok / Substack 三个风格包把钩子结构、段落节奏、标签规范做成显式约束；--lock 逐字锁定品牌名与链接。数据层 YAML 全开放——数据层就是产品。
body.en: Rewriting runs on your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint with one-command DeepSeek / Qwen / GLM / Kimi presets - no account, no middleman. Instagram / TikTok / Substack style packs turn hook structure, paragraph rhythm, and hashtag norms into explicit constraints; --lock preserves brand names verbatim. The data layer is open YAML - the data layer IS the product.

title.zh: 能读英文，和写得像母语者，是两回事
title.en: Reading English and writing native are different skills

body.zh: 出海创作者大多能顺读英文，但一落笔，评论区和数据都会提醒：这帖是「中国人写的AI稿」。三层中式痕迹——搭配迁移、语序迁移、客气套话——再叠一层 AI 腔，恰好都在英语单语工具的盲区里。Muyu 把这一层的检测、改写与验证做成一条工作台流水线：score 打分、rewrite 按平台改写、check 复检 delta。
body.en: Most overseas Chinese creators read English fine - then their comments remind them their drafts read like an AI wrote them in translation. Three layers of Chinese-mindset tells (collocation, word-order, politeness) plus generic AI cadence sit exactly in the blind spot of English-only tools. Muyu turns detection, rewriting, and verification into one workbench: score, rewrite per platform, check the delta.

body.zh: score 读入草稿，逐段标出命中的 tell 与严重度，给出 0-100 母语感分；rewrite 把每段连同它的 tell 命中、平台风格规则与锁定元素发给你的端点，输出 before/after 对照；check 复检改写稿并输出分类 delta。三条命令，一个闭环。
body.en: score reads the draft, flags matched tells per segment with severity, and returns a 0-100 native-tone score; rewrite sends each segment plus its tells, platform rules, and locked elements to your endpoint and renders before/after pairs; check re-scores the rewrite and emits the per-category delta. Three commands, one closed loop.

alt.zh: score → rewrite → check：打分、按平台分段改写、复检 delta。
alt.en: score → rewrite → check: score, per-platform segment rewrite, verify the delta.

body.zh: CLI 之下是三块数据资产：tell 库（68 条规则，YAML 外置可扩展）、平台风格包（钩子/节奏/规范/避雷）、评分器（纯规则可复现）。改写器只依赖一个 OpenAI 兼容端点，四家国产模型预设开箱即用。
body.en: Under the CLI sit three data assets: the tell library (68 rules, open YAML), the platform style packs (hook / rhythm / conventions / avoid-lists), and the scorer (pure rules, reproducible). The rewriter depends on a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint with four CN-model presets out of the box.

alt.zh: CLI、tell 库、评分器、OpenAI 兼容端点与平台风格包的数据流。
alt.en: Data flow across the CLI, tell library, scorer, OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and platform style packs.

note.zh: v0.2.0 的离线终端实录：score 两份原始草稿（40 分与 52 分）→ check 复检改写稿 native-1.md 的 delta（+60）→ presets 端点预设。演示直接对 examples/draft-*.md 与 examples/native-*.md 跑，不再把带原文的 before/after 对照页当输入。打分与复检全程离线、零模型调用；命令与输出逐字记录于 docs/demo-results.json，重跑逐字一致。
note.en: Real offline terminal output from v0.2.0: two raw drafts scored (40 and 52) -> check the delta on the rewritten native-1.md (+60) -> presets. The demo runs against examples/draft-*.md and examples/native-*.md, not the annotated before/after gallery page. Scoring and checking are fully offline with zero model calls; commands and outputs are recorded verbatim in docs/demo-results.json and reproduce byte-identically.

label.zh: score：Instagram 旅帖原始草稿 — 40 分

body.zh: 离线零模型调用，秒出：87 词的原始草稿命中 7 条 tell（搭配迁移/语序迁移/客气套话/AI 腔四类都有），母语感 40 分。每条命中带严重度与原文定位。
body.en: Offline and instant: the 87-word raw draft hits 7 tells across all four categories, native-tone 40. Every hit carries severity and location.

label.zh: score：Substack 长文原始草稿 — 52 分

body.zh: 议论文式开场与连接词链条（As we all know / Moreover / Furthermore）、AI 对仗句、三类客气套话——116 词命中 9 条 tell，52 分。
body.en: Essay-style openers and transition chains (As we all know, Moreover, Furthermore), AI parallelism, three politeness formulas - 9 tells in 116 words, score 52.

label.zh: check：改写稿 native-1.md 复检 — delta 可验证
label.en: check: re-score the rewritten native-1.md — verifiable delta

body.zh: 复检走同一个评分器，量的是改写稿本身（不是带原文的报告）：母语感 100 分，对基线 40 给出 +60。改写是不是真的更母语，看数字不看感觉。
body.en: The same scorer re-scores the rewrite itself (not the report, which still carries the original): native-tone 100, +60 against the baseline 40. Improvement is a number, not a vibe.

label.zh: presets：四家国产模型端点预设

body.zh: DeepSeek / Qwen / GLM / Kimi 一键预设，OpenAI 兼容端点走你自己的 key——无账号、无中间商。rewrite 命令消费它们。
body.en: One-command DeepSeek / Qwen / GLM / Kimi presets over an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with your own key - no account, no middleman. The rewrite command consumes them.

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+。score 与 check 全程离线、零模型调用；rewrite 需要一个 OpenAI 兼容端点（DeepSeek / Qwen / GLM / Kimi 一键预设），不配 key 也能完整走通打分-复检。
body.en: Requires Python 3.12+. score and check are fully offline with zero model calls; rewrite needs an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (one-command DeepSeek / Qwen / GLM / Kimi presets). Without a key you can still run the score-check loop end to end.

steps.code:
export MUYU_PRESET=deepseek MUYU_API_KEY=sk-...
muyu rewrite draft.md --platform substack --lock "Muyu" --out rewrite.md
